annotations.title: Approve, fix or drop a campaign review section

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] action "approve" approves the section's pending pieces (or pieceIds) and their held posts GO LIVE at their slots — needs the explicit `review` scope (admin does not include it); QA-failed pieces are skipped unless overrideQa. "fix" sends the pieces back with a `note` (required): their posts are taken off the schedule and the section opens a new round; other sections are untouched. "drop" takes the posts off the schedule and drops the pieces. "ready" puts fixed pieces back up for review. fix/drop/ready need `review` or `publish`. Agency plan. Confirm with the user first.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/campaigns/{id}/review/sections/{sectionId}.)

note.description: Required for fix: what to change. Quoted in the next round.

overrideQa.description: Approve pieces that failed QA anyway.

pieceIds.description: Only these pieces ("approve selected"). Default: every eligible piece in the section.
